description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various relational and visual concepts evaluated in a benchmark for assessing multi-granularity and multi-image relational association capabilities in large visual language models. The chart is divided into ten slices, each representing a different concept with its corresponding value and percentage. The concepts include NearSameEntity (63, 6.34%), ObservationAngle (126, 12.28%), SimilarMaterial (106, 10.33%), RelativePosition (81, 7.90%), MentalitySimilarity (89, 8.67%), SubEvent (100, 9.74%), UsageSimilarity (100, 9.65%), SimilarEvent (90, 8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (90, 8.77%), and Layout (90, 8.77%). Each slice is color-coded and labeled with the concept name, value, and percentage. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and the chart does not indicate any specific order of the slices.
